description: This file defines the WidgetInterface interface for Drupal field widget plugins, specifying methods for configuration, form rendering, validation, value processing, and applicability checks.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns a form to configure settings for the widget.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a short summary for the current widget settings.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Returns the form for a single field widget.

methods.name: errorElement
methods.description: Assigns a field-level validation error to the right widget sub-element.

methods.name: massageFormValues
methods.description: Massages the form values into the format expected for field values.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Returns if the widget can be used for the provided field.
